description: Use this when the user wants to verify DKIM for a domain. Pass the DKIM selector if known (for example google for Google Workspace, selector1 or selector2 for Microsoft 365). If the selector is unknown, omit it: mailX then tries common selectors and returns the ones it finds. Returns the published key and its status. A miss on common selectors does not prove DKIM is absent.

dkim_selector.description: The DKIM selector, e.g. google (Google Workspace), selector1 or selector2 (Microsoft 365). Optional: omit it to try common selectors.

domain_name.description: The domain to check DKIM records for, e.g. example.com

name: dkim_check
title: DKIM Check
